entries.name: rift_hunter_00
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied existing 4-column 3-row robot sprite sheet, genuine transparent background. The user says the walking feet close together with too small an angle. Change ONLY the leg articulation in ROWS TWO AND THREE, so the front and rear legs on each side remain visibly separated instead of folding together. Increase the forward/backward scissor angle between front and rear legs by about 20 degrees. Walking must be visibly articulated: row 2 robot-local front-left and rear-right feet advance and lift slightly, opposite pair plants back; row 3 the reverse diagonal pair advances. Front feet reach forward and rear feet backward so their silhouettes stay distinct, no feet overlap or cross. Keep a low grounded stance, not tall or hovering. Do not increase the overall width or scale of the robot. Keep ROW ONE completely unchanged. Keep the body / armor / red lights / silver joints / FOUR legs / material / lighting / all four exact camera headings / 4x3 grid / cell locations unchanged. The motion is at the joints only, not stretching or bending solid armor. Keep every foot inside its own cell with transparent clearance. Output 1448x1086 (4:3). No additional sprites, no shadows, no floor, no text, no glow haze, no motion blur. This is a leg-pose correction of an existing detailed asset, not a redesign. Preserve the two red dorsal lamps and side red knee armor. ROW TWO AND THREE should clearly look like opposite diagonal stepping poses, rather than nearly identical standing poses.
